## 8. Review Checklist

### Code Quality

- [ ] Code structure is appropriate.
- [ ] Code follows the project's coding standards.
- [ ] Code is readable and maintainable.
- [ ] No unnecessary files or debug statements are included.
- [ ] No unresolved merge conflicts remain.

### Testing & Reliability

- [ ] Relevant tests have been performed.
- [ ] Tests have been added or updated where necessary.
- [ ] Error handling is appropriate.
- [ ] Application behavior has been verified.

### Performance & Security

- [ ] Performance has been considered.
- [ ] Security implications have been considered.
- [ ] No sensitive information, credentials, or secrets have been exposed.

### Documentation

- [ ] Relevant documentation has been updated, where necessary.
- [ ] Configuration or environment changes have been documented.

### Final Checks

- [ ] I have reviewed my own changes.
- [ ] All applicable CI checks are passing.
- [ ] The PR is ready for review.
